newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates Commercial Bank of Korea C/D.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates Commercial Bank of Korea C/D.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it had assigned an individual rating of C/D to the Commercial Bank of Korea (CBK).

"The bank's previously assigned legal rating of 2 remains unchanged, reflecting IBCA's view that the Korean authorities would not allow the failure of any of the country's major banks," IBCA said in a statement.
shares many features in common with its peers among the former government-owned large commercial banks," IBCA said.
It said low profitability and poor asset quality, arising in large measure from government-directed lending in earlier years, were hallmarks of the government banks.
"In the case of CBK, these problems were compounded by above average exposure to Korea's troubled construction industry," it said.
But the rating agency said that it acknowledged that the bank was showing signs of recovery from its past troubles.
"It achieved an impressive increase in profits in 1995 and the first half of 1996, helped by improving asset quality and a favourable interest rate environment," IBCA said.
"Like other Korean banks, CBK trades actively in stocks and is currently suffering some adverse effects from the poor performance of the Korean stock market," it added.
